rule: The Central-Mountain boundary in South Dakota (49 CFR 71.7(b)) runs down the Missouri River from North Dakota to Pierre, then along the north line of Jones County and the west lines of Jones, Mellette and Todd counties; the fifteen counties listed lie wholly west of it, in the Mountain zone. Stanley County is split: its corner around Fort Pierre keeps Central time.

source.name: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb, State_County layer 1

split_counties.note: split by the boundary; the Fort Pierre corner keeps Central time
